metadata.description: End-to-end change-shipping automation — worktree isolation, engineer implementation, commit, push, PR creation, and CI monitoring until green. Merging stays manual.

plugins.description: End-to-end change-shipping toolkit: ship (worktree → implement → commit → push → PR → hand off to pr-watch), pr-watch (monitor CI → fix failures → report ready; never merges). Zero per-repo config — commands and branches detected from the repo.
plugins.name: supera
